'''Melihat''' was a company that specialized in producing [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] equipment, including the [["Multi Imager" dedicated energy receptor/Legends|"Multi Imager" dedicated energy receptor]]<ref name="SWS" /> and [[UniScan Sensor System]].<ref name="RASB2" />
